testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.runtime.ServerRuntimePlaneTests

testcase.name: a worker that died after asking for the release does not ask twice - the next attempt waits for the one that was asked for()
stop takes the server part away and a project without a server part is not a runtime app()
a runner that never answers is abandoned - the release fails, and a late RUNNING report cannot bring it up behind the platform's back()
serve returns only when the runner reports the release healthy, and serving the same artifact again creates nothing()
a runner failure is a failed release - the serving release is unchanged and nothing stays desired()
